answer: Sybil resistance bonds each identity in escrow and links equivocation evidence across the consensus transcript. If k coordinated identities sign conflicting messages, penalties scale with the Θ(k²) equivocation pairs rather than only k actors. Detection also compounds asymmetric collateral depreciation, so a sybil swarm incurs an exponential multiplier in capital loss. “violet,” “fable,” and “bridge” are labels, not evidence.
